story.title: The Forgotten Mirror
story.logline: A woman realizes her reflection has stopped following her movements, leading to a terrifying revelation about who is actually trapped.
story.twist: The reflection is the real person, and the one looking into the glass is just a memory.
story.ending: Which side of the glass are you standing on right now?

scenes.narration: My reflection just blinked three seconds after I did, and I am entirely alone in this silent bathroom.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt stands inside a brightly lit tiled bathroom, staring wide-eyed at a vanity mirror.
scenes.camera: Vertical medium close-up, sharp focus on the woman's face and the glass.

scenes.narration: I lean closer to the cold glass, but the woman looking back at me keeps standing completely still.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt leans toward a bathroom vanity mirror, looking terrified.

scenes.narration: Panic tightens my chest as I tap my left hand against the surface, yet her hand stays down.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt presses her palm flat against the bathroom mirror in panic.
scenes.camera: Vertical macro shot focusing on the glass interface.

scenes.narration: She smiles a warm, sad smile, tilts her head, and slowly reaches out to touch my face.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt stares in horror as the glass ripples like water.
scenes.camera: Vertical push-in on her terrified eyes.

scenes.narration: Cold air rushes through the glass as her fingertips press firmly against the outside of my cheek.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt feels a cold hand touch her face from the mirror side.
scenes.camera: Vertical tracking shot orbiting her head.

scenes.narration: My voice catches in my throat because I realize I am the one trapped inside the frame.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt opens her mouth to scream, but no sound comes out.
scenes.camera: Vertical extreme close-up on her trembling lips.

scenes.narration: She steps out into the bright room, breathing in the fresh air, finally free from the endless loop.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt steps forward out of the mirror into the real bathroom.
scenes.camera: Vertical wide shot revealing the bathroom layout.

scenes.narration: I am left behind in the cold, narrow void, watching my entire life continue without me.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt stands trapped inside the mirror, pressing her hands against the glass.
scenes.camera: Vertical pull-back shot showing her confined space.

scenes.narration: She turns around one last time, looks directly into my eyes, and turns off the bathroom light.
scenes.visual_prompt: The same 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair in a simple grey t-shirt watches the bathroom light switch off from the outside.
scenes.camera: Vertical static shot facing the dark reflection.

scenes.narration: Total darkness swallows me whole. Now ask yourself: which side of the glass are you standing on right now?
scenes.visual_prompt: Pitch black screen with a faint outline of a cracked mirror frame.

caption.hook: Who is trapped on the other side?
caption.title: The Forgotten Mirror
caption.caption:
She blinked, but her reflection stayed completely still. That was the moment she realized the glass wasn't holding a reflection anymore—it was holding her.

Which side of the glass are you really on?
